welcome.title:
Your books.
Your files.
welcome.lead: Read and listen to the DRM-free books you already own.

private.title: Nothing gets uploaded.
private.local: Your ebooks and audiobooks stay on your device.
private.privacy: What you read is private. We never see titles or files.

progress.title: Never lose your place.
progress.sync: Only your reading and listening progress follows you between devices.
progress.autosave: Your spot is saved automatically, even offline.

bring.title: One library for reading and listening.

signIn.title: Last step: save your place.
signIn.lead: Your account keeps your progress in sync. Your books stay on this phone.
signIn.returningLead: Sign in to pick up where you left off. Your books stay on this phone.
signIn.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

email.title: What’s your email?
email.lead: We’ll send you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
email.label: Email address
email.invalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.

verify.title: Check your email.
verify.lead: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
verify.label: 6-digit code
verify.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
verify.invalid: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again, or send a new one.

errors.offline: You’re offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
errors.notConfigured: This build isn’t connected to a backend yet. See .env.example.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in option isn’t set up in this build.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

switch.title: This phone has books from another account.
switch.lead: They stay hidden while you’re signed in. You can remove them to free up space.

empty.title: Your shelf is waiting.
empty.body: Bring an ebook or audiobook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.
empty.bodyAudio: Bring an audiobook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.
empty.bodyEbook: Bring an ebook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.
empty.comingSoon: Importing arrives in the next build.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Your listening and reading time will show up here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.signOutNote: Your books stay on this phone and come back when you sign in again.
